summary: The test suite is well-structured with comprehensive coverage of core requirements: classification of secrets into expired/warning/ok states, configurable warning windows, multi-format output (JSON/markdown), error handling, and workflow structure validation including actionlint checks and end-to-end execution via act. Excellent use of Pester organization with clear Describe/Context blocks, good test naming, and a sophisticated Invoke-WorkflowCase helper for parameterized workflow testing. However, three critical blockers prevent execution: the test code references fixture files (fixtures/cases/mixed.json, all-ok.json, all-expired.json), a workflow file (.github/workflows/secret-rotation-validator.yml), and a module file (src/SecretRotationValidator.psm1) that are not provided. The unit tests assume Import-Module and Get-Content succeed on these missing files, so BeforeAll will fail. Rigor gaps: no negative test cases through the workflow (e.g., malformed config, missing file), limited date edge cases (future-dated lastRotated, very large policy intervals), and no test of empty requiredBy arrays. The ROTATION_SUMMARY line format is only verified through act output strings, not in unit tests. Only 3 act test cases provided—more variety (e.g., single secret, large dataset) would strengthen confidence. If all prerequisite files existed and were correct, this would be a high-quality test suite; as-is, tests cannot be executed.
